entities.summary:
Anund, also known as Brøt-Anundr or Braut-Önundr, was a semi-legendary Swedish king of the House of Yngling who reigned in the mid-seventh century. The form of the name used during his lifetime would have been Proto-Norse *Anuwinduz, meaning 'winning ancestor'.






Anund's significance lies in his role as a key figure in the early Swedish state, marking the beginning of the Yngling dynasty and influencing the country's future monarchs.






His reign also corresponds with the period of significant Viking expansion, trade, and cultural exchange across Europe.
